book.name: JONI
book.title: Jisesi Kalaestida gala lalo Jonima luhuwa jibo

content: Laselesima helibo ga.
Beteni numutoya we mako uliwa Laselesiyo loko nebo weya saina elonebo ne. Aya weya olu emonala lowe minaiboya dulinipo Meleko Matakoya makoko numutotiya minaiye.
Meleya we napa Jisesidaya nuwala wibo netupa maya kiseko ilalo maya madona yopalaloti uli jeko le lalo oetaibo menamidana yatola maya saina elokaiyoko nebo ne.
Sakoya elokaiyoko neyoko, Jisesitoka maya sa-liki gaya hulaiye: We napayo, wewenaka maya saina napa elokaiyoko udone.
Liki laiyoko, Jisesimamo elekoko lina helituwe loko jelamiye, loko liye. Omaimidana luhuwalamaki ito nemo Omaimidana ipala luhuwanekiya soto pitiye loko jelene loko liye.
Jisesikahoya Laselesile Melele Matalesidaya uka benebo wewena minae.
Sayoko, Laselesida saina elaibo ga maya elekoko nebo numuto maya onawa loweya kolo meko udokoko,
unala ipalale yuhasida maya sa-loko lo limiye: Nisilo. Judiya ebakuka maya aku le wili jeko wetuniyo.
Loko liyoko, lemo sa-loko lo mune: Monoka ujapa wete yamalae, omutoko maya Juda wewenasida ujapa wenipolemasi kohaelatune liki labo maya nenako, aku aya ebakuka maya wetune loko nolape.

Loko lokuniyoko, Jisesimamo eimola helitibo onawa maya owaha neyoko, sa-loko lo limiye: Yowanu onawaya nekewahena ito holigahena ito ludakahenaya wavu-leko ne. Holiga maya lamedalo wideko wewena mako ahamuya sainapainahenaloti liki kohaidamikilae. Nemoya yowanu litubo onawane maya owaha ne.
Wewena mako lameda lamideko lubuka anu witaboya, mainahaloti mohiliki nisiki kohaidakilae.
Loko lo lemekoko amida meko sa-loko liye: Yowone Laselesi maya alo udo helekaiboya, aku woko ilime sinakoloe.
Loko liyoko, lemo unala ipalale sa-loko lune: We napate yamalae, omuda udonetiboya haka lekolaiye.
Loko ludawoya, Jisesimamo helekaka nesamuya koha moloko libo maya neboya, lemoya ele wehe lamoko aha udonebokumu lihe loko opaya lune.
Loko lokuniyoko, alikaya Jisesimamo lo soto moloko sa-loko lo limiye:

Nemoya yaloka maya wamoko, malokagoya minoyoko, Laselesi maya alo helekaiboya, edimokumuye loko elewole oko elekakatipomidana ihilawa maya soto pitiye loko obohaneu maya aila uluma nosiliye. Sa-okainako, ayalokaya wetune.
Loko liyoko, Tomasiya uliwa mako Lobetokoe loko nebo welimoya welalesida maya sa-loko lo limiye: Lemokiya magoina woko heletune. 1 Luk 10:38-39; 2 Jon 12:3
Jisesiya helebokuti siniki elewole iki minikaka nesamidana aholaya ne.
Loko lokaiyoko, magoina wudawoya, Laselesida ale li jitabo onawa maya loweki lowekiya wokaiyoko, Jisesima woko aya numuto maya hetokoko aya ga maya eliye.
Sa-iboya aya Beteni numudaya Jelusalemu numutoka alili nebo ne.
Sa-iyoko, Meleko Matako yanipo maya helekaiyoko, Juda wewenahena mukiya wiki wije nama libitakili wae.
Sa-niayoko, Mata maya Jisesima nonisiye liki laboya elekoko Mele maya numuku neyoko woko anuloka hotula iye.
Sakiya Jisesiki hotula ikiki Matamamo sa-loko lo miye: We napane yamalae, emoya malo minatidanako, nemo yane maya sako helametine.
Olotiya emo monawaka maya ele-minoe. Matoka nesamuya woko Omailoka letadawoya ele imitibo ne.
Loko liyoko, Jisesimamo yatokaya aha momoga oko sinakolaiye, loko liye.
Loko liyoko, Matamamo sakoya minoko onawa napalo maya Omailimo muki wewena dilipe sinatiboto maya ilime sinatibomu lihelae nata ele-minoe.
Loko liyoko, Jisesimamo helebokuti siniki elewole depa mutiwa likakamidana aholaya nemoya minoe. Wewena mako nemokumu elewole iki data kitabo wewena maya helikiki aku siniki elewole iki minakilae.

Ito domuda li-minabo wewenasiya nemokumu elewole iki data kitaboya, depa mutiwa maya suwamekolaiye. Aya depa mutiwaya mino-loko woko minakolaiye. Sa-oneyoko noloyo, emoya nolobo ga maya eleko nemesalo nomolape.

Loko loka oetaiyoko, Matamamo we napane yamalae, emoya Omailimo lahelamibo nesauti lilimitiye loko lo mololetaibo we Omaimidana ipala maya ma mikau leme-minane liki labo we maya minane loko emodamuya nukaloti elewole oko ele-minoe.
Jisesima wije ibo.
Loko lokadanaki, olu unala Meleda maya ju lo meko sumika loko sa-loko lo miye: Monoka ujapalo we maya nisekoko emodamu noliye.
Loko liyoko, elekoko, Mele maya enemane oko sinokoko Jisesima nebotoka wiye.
Sako nowiyoko, Jisesima numutoka wamoko, Matada ga lo mibo ebato maya ne.

Sakoya neyoko, Mele maya enemane oko sinokoko wiyoko, Juda wewena nisiki numudalau wije nama liki minabo wewenamasiya Laselesida molitabo aleloka maya woko wije nama lekolo wihe likiki emesalo moliki wae.
Melema Jisesi neboto wokoko i bola heko udokoko sa-loko lo miye: We napane yamalae, emoya malo aha minatidanako, yatone maya helametine.
Loko lokoko wije iye. Wije noiyoko, Juda wewena emeke moliki wabolawamaki emesalo moliki wije ae. Wije nama nileyoko Jisesimamo mudaidokoko ukauka miluma elekoko sa-loko loka obetoko liye;
Nakahaukama ale jiti-minae, loko liyoko, we napate yamalae, niseko mudataniyo, nisegae, liki lae.
Liki layoko, Jisesimamo omudalauti maya leke leke liyoko, wije nama liye.
Wije nama liyoko, Juda wewenamasiya mudalo, Laselesidaya ukala me ilitone, liki lae.
Liki layoko, maloka wewenamasiya omutoko omudala likaibo we makomidana le pana ketaibo maya nenako, olotiya maya wemidana ilime haka lideko helametibo neboya, samiye liki lae.
Laselesima helenebokuti ilime sinaibo.
Liki likayoko, Jisesima aku mulunauka miluma napa elekoko, ono molikakaku maya yoweko ehada numuda ateto maya ehada napaloti moli li labo ehada maya,
mudakoko sa-loko liye: Ehada maya ipisiki li hulalo. Loko liyoko, helibo wemidana emonala Matamamo we napane yamalae, onawa loweki loweki yupekaya minokainako, alo nuwama wonetibo ne.
Loko liyoko, Jisesimamo emoya ga lo emoboya elamape, elewole oko elitadawoya, Omaimidana elewoleyala maya soto pideko mudakolane.
Loko liyoko, ehada maya koliki li hulikayoko, Jisesimamo omuda hulo okulumauka moloko, ahone yaliyo emotoka noloboya ele-minane.
Ito muki yupeka emotoka lokaka noboma elekaka noadawo maya ne loko eleminoboya, maya li esa iki minabo wewenasiya emokaho noli heniyoko lemobo ne liki eli wehe litae loko noloe.
Loko lokoko, ga napauti ju loko Laselesiyo, emoya sinokoko nisowo.
Loko liyoko, ilo adelo nala jebo nalahenamaki aha neyoko, sinokoko nisiyoko Jisesimamo nalahena yomaya wina iki li hulitalo, liyoko nalahena maya wina iki li hulitae.
Jisesida kohaikili emega labo.
Sa-ikayoko, Juda wewena malokasiya nisiki Meleko Matako minaibotoka miniki wije nama liki minabo wewenasiya Jisesima oko moloko ibo nesa maya mudaikiki Jisesidamuya data elewole iki keboya,
maloka wewenasiya wiki Palasisi wewenasitoka maya wetome iki li be.
Sa-ikayoko aya wewenaki ito Omaitoka jokila hi mikaka wehenakiya monoka Kanisolesida maya lesa molikiki sa-liki lae: Maya welimoya lowa-lawa nesa maya lolo okainako, lemoya nenaha lolo oetatune.

Lemoya mudaikoko minuniyoko aya nesaya sa-oloko wowa wowa ideko muki wewenasiya emotokago wiki omiki suwikilae. Sa-ideko Lomu wewenasida imi wesiya nisiki lemodaya lowa hi limiki kohale-liki wau loli hikiki monoka numudate napa maya liki tolowa ikilae.
Liki layoko, edimokuti we mako uliwa Kaeyapasiya aya melekeuya Omaitoka jokila hi mikaka wesida uliki wenipo lolo ibo nenako, ya wemamo edimoya nei minanako, sa-liki elamae loko liye.
Lemo Juda wewenaya woko aha nesa lolo okatudanako, ya welimoya muki lilime nupa napa oko helekadeko, yalimoya saina ihilawa le soto mololetatiye.

Loko liboya eimola atauti yowiyoko lamiye. Emoya aya melekeloya Omaitoka jokila hi mikaka wesida ujapa wenipo lolo ibo nenako, Omailimo ilime sahu iyoko Jisesima muki wewenasidamuye loko helitibo onawamuya ohuwa hukoko liye.
Sa-loko liboya, Juda wewenamugo helitibokumu lamiye. Omaimidana wewenala numuto namato minabosida maya dilipe nupa napa okadeko, nala makoko jiki minatabokumu helitiye loko ohuwa hukoko lo biye.
Loko liyoko, Omaitoka jokila hi mikaka wemasiya ya yupeka maya Jisesida kohatune liki lowa je.

Sa-ikayoko nenako, Jisesima Judiya ebaku wewenasi domudaloka maya lemo jamoko woko ame mikaloka maya ne. Yamidana apilalokaya numuda mako Ipiliyamuyo loko nebotoya unala ipalale yuhamaki magoinaya woko minune.

Yaloka maya woko minuniyoko, Juda wewenasida esenipo vobetaibo holi onawa maya alili okaiyoko, muki numuda lasomosolaukati maya hulikiki dukanipo no jiki li uluwitikiki li Jelusalemu numutokago wiwi ae.

Sakiya wiki Omaimitoka jokila hi mikaka numuda napau maya yowikiki Jisesima owaha nisamiyoko, ohu nijiki sa-liki edimonipo minabotokaya nenae liki niele, Jisesiya holi onawauya nisitibo nehe ito nisametibo ne, liki ligi hagi ae.

Liki laboya Omaitoka jokila hi mikaka weki ito Palasisi wekiya, wewena makolimoya Jisesima netibo ebaya mudakoko niseko lideko nala metudanako liki li moliki labotoya Jisesima holi onawau maya nisametibo nehe liki lae.
